recommendation: Keep the source fix. If FHIR-16148 is audited separately later, cite this commit as evidence that the remaining Encounter wording gap was closed under the FHIR-38807 umbrella; do not re-add absent or retired Encounter.reason reference targets without a separate current work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-38807 was a Published/Persuasive R5 ballot reconciliation issue asking Patient Administration to apply outstanding Encounter trackers, including Encounter.reason and Encounter.diagnosis updates that missed the September 2022 R5 ballot publication.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied through PR #2650, merged as 3ac1ab47dd, whose message explicitly lists FHIR-38807. Implementation commit 084c723e14 applied the Encounter.reason and Encounter.diagnosis structural changes from FHIR-16148 and the EpisodeOfCare alignment from FHIR-35863, but the current Encounter source still retained stale prose describing Encounter.reason as an episode-of-care concept and Encounter.diagnosis as merely relevant to the encounter.
additional_context: FHIR-16148 is the tightly related final decision defining the Encounter.reason and Encounter.diagnosis wording, and Confluence page 51223352 records it as the master tracker for this design family. Later FHIR-38784 made Encounter.reason.use and Encounter.diagnosis.use repeat, so those current cardinalities were preserved. Later FHIR-48869 synchronized EpisodeOfCare.reason for R6 and was already represented on the combined branch; it did not require further EpisodeOfCare changes here. Encounter is active and approved in source/fhir.ini.
reconciliation: Updated source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml so Encounter.reason is about reasons expected during the encounter, Encounter.diagnosis is the list of medical conditions addressed during the encounter, and Encounter.diagnosis.condition uses the approved CodeableReference wording. Updated source/encounter/encounter-event-mapping-exceptions.xml and source/encounter/encounter.svg so mapping exception text and checked-in diagram tooltips do not contradict the authoritative XML.
source_changes: source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml: corrected Encounter.reason, Encounter.diagnosis, and Encounter.diagnosis.condition definitions/comments to match the applied Encounter redesign.
source/encounter/encounter-event-mapping-exceptions.xml: synchronized Event mapping exception resource text for Encounter.diagnosis.condition.
source/encounter/encounter.svg: synchronized checked-in diagram tooltips for Encounter.reason, Encounter.diagnosis, and Encounter.diagnosis.condition.
